name: karma
notes: Angular with Karma. The wrapper maps each spec file to its angular.json project and runs `ng test <project> --include <spec>` with an inline JUnit reporter; it adds no npm dependency. Proof ids: path/to/x.spec.ts::describe title it title. Limits: (1) Karma does not report a test's file, so the file is found by the top-level describe title (two files with the same title can be confused); (2) a spec that no project's tsconfig.spec.json includes never runs - it is skipped with a warning, so cover that code from an included spec. Run `node .atw/core/presets/karma/karma-run.cjs --dry-run <spec>` to see the mapping.
